findings.title: Page incorrectly says nothing was pooled
findings.page_quote: Nothing was pooled on this page
findings.why: Two trial families contribute a pooled point estimate. The registered confidence interval and significance claim are refused; pooling itself is not absent.
findings.fix: Explain that no checkable pooled significance claim exists because the registered k=2 interval is refused.

findings.title: Refused confidence interval appears as an unexplained blank

evidence.quote: Registered PM/HKSJ uses t(1)=12.71 at k=2; the interval is not served as a pooled confidence interval because a single degree of freedom is not reliable here.

findings.why: The Analysis table presents an empty interval beside the pooled estimate without explaining the explicit refusal recorded in the source and displayed in Results.
findings.fix: Render the recorded refusal code and explanation instead of an empty interval.

findings.title: Heterogeneity values lose their recorded qualification

evidence.quote: STALE: pooled membership known incomplete (3 eligible families not in the pool); tau^2, I^2 and the prediction interval are descriptive only, not interpretable.

findings.why: Analysis displays unqualified zero heterogeneity, while the source and Results explicitly warn that incomplete membership prevents interpretation.
findings.fix: Carry the recorded qualification into the Analysis table.
